widths.note: 50' NE of Clifton; the not-open part SW of Clifton is labelled 45' near Clifton and 50' near McMicken

bends.note: Clifton turns from NW-SE (north part, about 57 deg off vertical) to SSE (about 33 deg off vertical)
McMicken turns from ESE to SSE here (same point as the Ohio Av. junction) and runs SSE off the bottom of the sheet
Vine bends to run NNE north of here (west line and water pipe both turn); east line is off the page

ends.note: east end at the Bellevue Inclined Plane Railway right of way

notes: Names printed without a suffix (ELM, HENRY, RACE, VINE, PLEASANT, RENNER) are written with 'Street'; N. ELM written as North Elm Street (printed 'N. ELM (NOT OPEN)' on the north part). Elm and North Elm meet McMicken at two points ~220 px apart (two T points); this North Elm is the unnamed '?' street on sheet 218. Ohio Av. jogs about 20 ft at W. Clifton Av.: NE part (50', open) meets Clifton at (5063,4516), the not-open SW part at (5126,4621). Ohio Av. meets McMicken exactly at McMicken's bend; Race St. ends at McMicken ~140 px west of that, with an open wedge between Race and McMicken south of it. Clifton ends at Vine (both run off the east edge; the crossing centre is on the page, the Vine east line is not). Henry St. jogs at Elm: the Henry Street on this sheet (y~7012) lines up with the '?' street east of Elm on sheet 218, not with the street labelled Henry west of Elm there. A 10 ft alley, unnamed here, runs from McMicken south to Henry at x~2525 and crosses Henry; it is labelled HAFER ALLEY south of Henry on sheet 220, so it is recorded as Hafer Alley. Public steps run from W. Clifton Av. (~1450,600) down past Renner to N. Elm and the 4 in. water pipe crosses lots from Clifton to Renner; neither is a street. W. Clifton Av. and Renner St. run off NW into the blank sheet-230 area, and Ohio Av. runs off NE into the blank sheet-232 area; these are not real ends. Bellevue Inclined Plane Railway and lumber-yard drives ignored. Vine Street's centre is close to the binding on this sheet (west line ~6165 at y4300, ~6075 at y6650; 66 ft wide), so Vine points use the west line plus ~206 px; the Clifton/Vine point is where the Clifton centreline (midway between its building lines) meets that line, not the pipe junction.
